paper_id: Dong et al. - 2013 - Measurement and analysis on the packet delivery performance in a large scale sensor network
title: Measurement and Analysis on the Packet Delivery Performance in A Large Scale Sensor Network
motivation: 现有大规模WSN对各层协议联合影响下的丢包根因缺乏系统性理解,影响系统优化和应用开发
problem_framing: 将网络丢包分解为可归因的具体类别,建立时空调度关联以揭示根因
key_insight: 利用因果图对触发事件与丢包事件做时空关联分析,揭示不同丢包类型的空间分布特征各异
method_signature: MAP方法学:稳健算法识别丢包与系统事件,因果图追踪交互,时空相关性分析
evaluation_criteria: PDR(分组投递率)及各根因占比,含loop/correlation/false positive率
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 数据源仅含数据分组,无法捕获完整系统事件;33.43%丢包无法关联根因
evidence_for_taste: we usually do not know how and to what extent
The multiple impacts of a single trigger
we do not examine the correlations among different events
current ready-to-use TinyOS low power protocol stack is not good enough
93% of the loop events do not cause overflow drops
the current packet-level CRC mechanism cannot guarantee
we cannot associate with root causes
thinking_moves: 从总体性能指标反推具体根因类别(先分类再归因)
用因果图替代统计相关,追踪trigger→loss的传导路径
观察可视化模式(vertical/horizontal banding)触发诊断假设
承认数据不完整,不硬凑因果,留33%为unknown
把协议性能差距作为baseline评判自身方法的有效性
cites_own_work: Liu et al., 2011 - GreenOrbs measurement study (INFOCOM)
extraction_notes: 论文正文中未明确标注会议/期刊名称,年份从论文结构推断为2013,DOI缺失,但核心方法论和作者角色信息完整提取
